interaction_rules: Raise amount validates in real-time: must be >= min raise and <= remaining stack; invalid disables confirm
Action buttons are contextually enabled/disabled — invalid actions never shown
Storage quota warnings appear as non-blocking toast notifications
Data deletion requires explicit modal confirmation dialog
Action panel visible only during user turn; slides up on narrow, fixed right on desktop
Fold/Check/Call are single-tap instant; Raise opens slider; All-in requires confirmation
Replay keyboard shortcuts: arrow keys for prev/next, 1-4 for street jump
GTO overlay panel stays visible and updates per decision point during replay
Card deal animation 200ms, chip movement 300ms, BOT action delay 500-1500ms randomized
GTO color coding: green (#22c55e) = match, yellow (#eab308) = minor deviation <0.5BB, red (#ef4444) = major deviation >=0.5BB
Every completed hand auto-saves to IndexedDB; incomplete hands discarded
Storage warning at >10000 hands or >50MB IndexedDB usage
Statistics recalculated from raw hand data on dashboard open
Minimum supported viewport width 1024px, primary target 1280px+
